Text: As the Scout, use your 'Double Jump' ability when you are unsure of an answer. It will allow you to skip the question, immediately getting it right.
As the Soldier, use your 'Buff Banner' ability when you are already on a streak of correctly answered questions to make best use of the bonus.
As the Pyro, use your 'Flare Gun' ability to score triple points on a question if you got the previous answer correct.
As the Demoman, your 'Eyelander' ability will grant you more points for every answer you get right up to a maximum of 2 extra points.
As the Heavy, use your 'Brass Beast' ability to remove 2 answers from the potential choices, giving you a 50/50 shot at answering correctly.
As the Engineer, use your 'Teleporter' ability when you wish to return to another question and have another attempt.
As the Medic, use your 'Übercharge' ability to gain immunity to incorrect answers for 3 questions.
As the Sniper, use your 'Razorback' ability when you are unsure of your answer to gain another try.
As the Spy, use your 'Disguise Kit' ability to switch to an easier set of BLU side questions in order to gain points more easily.
